decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (983C/01 Rev A, 983C/02 Rev A, 983C/03 Rev A, 983C/04 Rev A, 983C/05 Rev A, 983C/06 Rev A, 983C/07 Rev A, 983C/08 Rev A, 983C/09 Rev A (received 27/11/2013)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The ground floor of Holdsworth House, 65-73 Staines Road, shall be used for retail (A1), professional services (A2) and D1 medical use only and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A and D1 respectively of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 4 - The retail use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 0600 and 2300 Monday to Sunday.
Condition : 5 - All Servicing shall take place from the rear parking area of the site.
description: Change of use of part of ground floor from B1 (office) use to mixed A1 (retail use), A2 (financial and professional services) and D1 (medical use) and the installation of new doors and rollershutters to shop front
